faq-b1.q: How do I book a cab with KANDY CABS?
faq-b1.a: Open the app, select your pickup and drop-off locations, choose your travel type (One Way, Round Trip, or Local Airport) and preferred vehicle, review the fixed fare and trip details, and proceed to confirmation. Once confirmed, you can track driver assignment in My Bookings.

faq-b2.q: How do I select my pickup location?
faq-b2.a: Enter your pickup address in the location search bar or tap the map to pinpoint your exact spot. Check the displayed city, landmark, and building name carefully before confirming your booking.

faq-b3.q: How do I choose a vehicle?
faq-b3.a: Select from the available vehicle categories displayed for your route (e.g. Sedan, Ertiga, Innova, Crysta). Review seating capacity, luggage capability, AC amenities, and all-inclusive transparent fare before confirming.

faq-b4.q: Where can I find my booking details?
faq-b4.a: Tap 'My Bookings' in the bottom dock at any time to view your booking reference, status, assigned driver details, vehicle registration, travel schedule, and payment summary.

faq-b5.q: Can I book a cab for someone else?
faq-b5.a: Yes. In the Additional Details step during booking, enter the actual passenger's name and mobile number. All trip updates, driver assignment details, and OTP will be sent directly to their phone.

faq-p1.a: Your fare is transparent and all-inclusive. It is calculated based on vehicle class, trip type, total distance/package kilometres, driver allowance, and toll estimates. Review the complete fare breakdown on the summary screen before confirmation.

faq-p2.q: How can I make a payment?
faq-p2.a: You can pay securely online via UPI, Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, or pay directly to the driver via cash or UPI upon trip completion, depending on the booking configuration.

faq-p3.a: Check your internet connection and bank UPI limits. Do not immediately pay again if the amount may have been debited. Check 'My Bookings' first. If the amount was deducted without confirmation, contact Support with your bank transaction UTR reference.

faq-p4.q: How can I check my advance payment?
faq-p4.a: Open 'My Bookings', select your booking card, and review the Payment Breakdown. It displays the advance paid, balance due to the driver, and payment mode.

faq-p5.q: Will I get a tax invoice for my booking?
faq-p5.a: Yes. Official GST-compliant tax invoices are automatically generated upon trip completion. You can download your invoice directly from My Bookings or request a copy sent to your email.

faq-c1.q: Can I cancel or reschedule my booking?
faq-c1.a: Open 'My Bookings', select the active booking, and tap 'Cancel Booking' or 'Reschedule'. Free cancellation is typically available up to 2 hours prior to scheduled departure. Check the policy details on your booking screen.

faq-c2.q: Will I receive a refund after cancellation?
faq-c2.a: If your booking is eligible for a refund under our cancellation policy, the refund is initiated automatically to your original source of payment (UPI, Bank Account, or Card).

faq-c3.q: How long does a refund take?
faq-c3.a: UPI and wallet refunds are processed within 24 to 48 hours. Bank account and credit/debit card refunds typically reflect within 3 to 7 business days depending on your issuing bank.

faq-d1.q: How can I contact my assigned driver?
faq-d1.a: Once a driver is assigned (usually 1-2 hours before outstation trips or immediately for instant rides), their name, phone number, vehicle model, and registration plate appear on your active booking card with a direct 'Call Driver' button.

faq-d2.q: What should I do if my driver is delayed?
faq-d2.a: Check the live trip tracking on the booking card or tap 'Call Driver'. If the driver is unreachable or delayed beyond 15 minutes, tap 'App Support Helpline' or Call Us immediately for backup vehicle dispatch.

faq-d3.q: Why do I need to provide an OTP?
faq-d3.a: A unique 4-digit Ride Start OTP protects your safety by ensuring only authorized passengers board the designated cab. Share your OTP with the driver only after verifying the vehicle registration number and sitting safely inside.

faq-d4.q: What should I do if the driver or vehicle details do not match?
faq-d4.a: Do NOT board the vehicle if the license plate or driver differs from your booking card. Call our 24x7 Customer Helpline (+91 99008 87777) immediately. For immediate personal danger, press Emergency SOS or call 112.

faq-d5.q: What should I do if I leave an item in the cab?
faq-d5.a: Contact our support desk immediately with your booking reference, travel date, and description of the lost item. We will contact the assigned chauffeur to retrieve and return your belongings.

faq-a1.q: I cannot log in. What should I do?
faq-a1.a: Verify your 10-digit mobile number and mobile network. If you do not receive the SMS OTP, wait 30 seconds before tapping 'Resend OTP'. If the issue persists, contact App Support at +91 91873 36058.

faq-a2.q: I am not receiving my OTP.
faq-a2.a: Ensure your SIM has active SMS service and no DND blocking on transactional messages. Restart the app or check if airplane mode is off. You can also tap App Support Helpline for immediate technical resolution.

faq-a3.q: The app is not showing my current location.
faq-a3.a: Go to your phone's Settings > Apps > KANDY CABS > Permissions, and enable 'Location' set to 'Allow while using the app' with 'Precise Location' enabled. Also check that your device GPS is switched on.

faq-a4.q: I am not receiving trip notifications.
faq-a4.a: Ensure push notifications are allowed in your device Settings for KANDY CABS. Important booking confirmations and driver details will also always be available inside the 'My Bookings' tab.

faq-a5.q: The app is crashing or not working properly.
faq-a5.a: Close and restart the app, or clear app cache in Android Settings. Ensure you are running the latest app version. You can submit an App Support ticket below or call our technical helpline at +91 91873 36058.

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By registering or accessing the KANDY CABS application, you agree to comply with these Terms & Conditions, the applicable Booking Policy, Cancellation Policy, Privacy Policy, and Ride Safety Guidelines. If you do not agree, you must not proceed.

sections.title: Eligibility and Account Registration
bullets: Customers must provide accurate and complete registration details.
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and OTPs.
Do not create fake accounts, impersonate another person, or misuse the application.
KANDY CABS may restrict or suspend accounts for suspected fraud, misuse, or unlawful activity, subject to applicable law.

sections.title: Booking and Confirmation
bullets: A booking request is subject to vehicle availability and confirmation by KANDY CABS.
Customers must provide correct pickup and drop-off addresses, travel dates, reporting times, contact numbers, passenger count, and luggage details.
Changes to the itinerary, pickup time, destination, or vehicle category must be communicated in advance and may result in revised charges.
Customers should rely on the final booking confirmation for the agreed trip details and price.

sections.title: Fares, Taxes and Additional Charges
bullets: The applicable fare and inclusions will be communicated before booking confirmation.

Toll charges, parking fees, permits, state taxes, additional kilometres, waiting time, night allowances, or other trip-related charges may apply where disclosed in the quotation or applicable booking conditions.
GST and other applicable taxes will be charged as required by law.
Any additional charges must be explained and supported by the applicable booking terms or actual trip expenses, as relevant.

sections.title: Payments and Invoices
bullets: Customers must pay through the payment methods officially authorised by KANDY CABS.

For safety and transparency, customers are requested not to make cash payments directly to the chauffeur. Payments should be made through authorised online channels against the applicable invoice or payment request.
Customers should retain their payment confirmation and contact KANDY CABS if a payment discrepancy arises.
Invoices and receipts will be issued according to the applicable billing process.

sections.title: Cancellation, Rescheduling and Refunds
bullets: Cancellation and rescheduling charges, if any, will be governed by the cancellation policy communicated for the booking.
Refund eligibility and processing timelines depend on the applicable policy, payment provider, and circumstances of cancellation.
If KANDY CABS must cancel or materially change a confirmed booking, the customer will be informed and offered an appropriate resolution under the applicable policy and law.

sections.title: Customer Responsibilities
bullets: Be present at the confirmed pickup location at the scheduled time.
Ensure all passengers wear seat belts and comply with applicable safety laws.
Treat chauffeurs respectfully and refrain from abusive, threatening, discriminatory, or unlawful behaviour.
Do not request speeding, dangerous driving, illegal stops, or violations of traffic regulations.
Do not carry prohibited, illegal, dangerous, or hazardous items in the vehicle.
Keep personal belongings secure and check the vehicle before leaving.

sections.title: Passenger Safety and Emergency Situations
bullets: Customers should verify the vehicle and chauffeur details provided in the app or booking confirmation before boarding.
Any safety concern, accident, harassment, suspected misconduct, or emergency should be reported promptly to the appropriate emergency services and KANDY CABS.
Chauffeurs may refuse requests that would violate traffic laws or compromise passenger safety.
Children must be accompanied and supervised by a responsible adult, with suitable child restraints used where required.

sections.title: Trip Duration and Route
bullets: Estimated arrival times are indicative and may vary due to traffic, weather, road closures, vehicle restrictions, or other circumstances beyond reasonable control.
Extra kilometres, additional stops, route deviations requested by the customer, and extensions beyond the agreed package may incur additional charges according to the confirmed fare terms.
Drivers must follow applicable laws and prioritise road safety.

sections.title: Luggage and Personal Belongings
bullets: Customers must disclose luggage quantities and oversized items in advance.
Luggage must fit safely within the available vehicle capacity.
KANDY CABS should be notified promptly if any item is lost or left behind. Recovery and delivery arrangements may be subject to availability and reasonable disclosed costs.

sections.title: Privacy and Personal Information
bullets: Customer information may be used for account creation, booking management, payment processing, trip coordination, customer support, safety, and legal compliance.
Location information may be processed where necessary for pickup coordination, navigation, trip tracking, and safety, subject to the app's permissions and Privacy Policy.
Personal information will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws and the KANDY CABS Privacy Policy.
Promotional communications should be handled in accordance with applicable consent and communication preferences.

sections.title: Service Availability and Limitations
bullets: Vehicle and chauffeur availability may vary by location, date, time, and service category.
KANDY CABS will make reasonable efforts to provide the confirmed service but cannot guarantee that the application will always be uninterrupted or error-free.
Nothing in these terms excludes liability or consumer rights that cannot legally be excluded under applicable law.

sections.title: Complaints and Customer Support
sections.body: Customers may report booking issues, billing discrepancies, service complaints, or safety concerns through the support details displayed in the application or on the official website: www.kandycabs.in. Complaints will be handled in accordance with applicable law and the company's grievance procedure.

sections.title: Updates to These Terms
sections.body: KANDY CABS may update these terms when required for operational, legal, or service-related reasons. Material changes will be communicated as appropriate. Where fresh acceptance is legally required or necessary for continued use, customers will be asked to review and accept the updated terms.

sections.title: Governing Law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the applicable laws of India. Disputes will be handled by the competent authorities or courts having jurisdiction under applicable law, without limiting any statutory consumer rights.
